collection.title: Mercedes-Benz S Class Convertible 2017 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz S Class Convertible 2017 - 2020 will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. Please Note - These blades are not suitable for the Built-in Washer Jets.
